info.name: Content Credentials
info.summary: Detect and inspect C2PA Content Credentials in PDFs, images, audio and video
info.description:
Checks files for embedded **C2PA Content Credentials** (the provenance manifests produced by Adobe, OpenAI, camera vendors and others) and shows the result right in the Files app:
* a badge next to the file name (valid, invalid or remote manifest) * a **Credentials** sidebar tab with signer, signing time, creating app, AI-generation hints, edit history, ingredients and the raw manifest
Supported formats include PDF, JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, TIFF, HEIC/HEIF, AVIF, JPEG XL, DNG, SVG, MP4/MOV, MP3, WAV, FLAC and Office/OpenDocument files.
Existing files are scanned in the background after installation; new uploads are scanned automatically.
Verification is done offline with the official c2pa-rs SDK (bundled `c2pa-scan` binary). Remote manifests are only downloaded when a user clicks *Fetch remote manifest* in the sidebar (admins can turn that off). No trust list is configured, so correctly signed credentials are reported as *valid* (cryptographically intact) rather than *trusted*.
info.author: Leon Namowitz
